messages:
Maria: Heads up — I pushed a new dashboard and a couple of telemetry metrics for the runtime team: `runtime.slo_burn_rate`, `runtime.request_error_rate`, and `runtime.request_qps_by_model`.
Ajay: Nice, can you drop the dashboard link and the PromQL you're using for the SLO burn?
Maria: Dashboard: https://redwood.internal/dashboards/runtime-slo-burn
Maria: PromQL (rough sketch):
```
sum(rate(runtime_slo_burn_total[5m])) / sum(rate(runtime_slo_allowed_total[5m]))
```
Maria: We want an alert when the burn rate > 4 for a 5m window OR > 2 for a 1h window.
Kristen: Are we planning to route the 5m high-burn alerts to runtime-oncall (P0) and the 1h ones to platform-oncall (P1)?
Leo: I think runtime-oncall should get the immediate burn spike (5m) — they can fast-failover model variants. Platform should own sustained burns that might be infra or routing issues.
Samir: Two questions: (1) how do we detect quota-throttling vs real model regressions? (2) what labels do we need on metrics so routing works?
Maria: Good Qs. For (1) add `quota_rejected` metric (we already emit `runtime.request_quota_rejected_total`). For (2) labels: `team`, `model`, `region`, `failure_kind` (eg: "infra", "model", "quota").
Ajay: Suggestion for alert rules (Prometheus Alertmanager style):
```
- alert: RuntimeSLOBurn_P0
  expr: (sum by (model, region) (rate(runtime_slo_burn_total[5m])) / sum by (model, region) (rate(runtime_slo_allowed_total[5m]))) > 4
  for: 5m
  labels:
    severity: P0
    route: runtime
  annotations:
    runbook: "https://redwood.internal/runbooks/runtime-slo-burn"

- alert: RuntimeSLOBurn_P1
  expr: (sum by (model) (rate(runtime_slo_burn_total[1h])) / sum by (model) (rate(runtime_slo_allowed_total[1h]))) > 2
  for: 1h
  labels:
    severity: P1
    route: platform
```
Kristen: That looks good. For routing, can we make the alertmanager use the `failure_kind` label to choose infra vs runtime teams? If `failure_kind=="infra"` go to infra-oncall, else runtime-oncall.
Leo: Yes, we have a mapping table we can reference in the alertmanager config. I'll add `failure_kind` to the matching rules.
Maria: Also adding a derived alert: if `quota_rejected` spikes concurrently with slo_burn, mark `failure_kind=quota` automatically via a recording rule.
Samir: How about noisy-model protection? If a single low-traffic model has a tiny number of allowed tokens, burn rate can be noisy. Maybe require min request QPS threshold: `sum(rate(runtime_request_qps_by_model[5m])) > 0.5` to fire P0.
Ajay: Good call. Add that to expr: AND clause for min qps.
Maria: Updated expr example in thread later.
ops-bot: New metric pipeline deployed: `runtime.slo_burn_rate` ingest -> stable, 3 replicas, retention 15d. :white_check_mark:
Maria: Runbook link again: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/runtime-slo-burn (contains rollback steps and checklists).
Kristen: On the dashboard UX: can we show the SLO burn with three panes — global, by-region, by-model — and have an inline legend that surfaces `failure_kind` so oncall can triage faster?
Leo: Yep. I'll add collapsible panels and quick links to the runbook + incident create button.
Samir: For oncall routing specifics: propose route table:
- if severity P0 and failure_kind != infra => runtime-oncall
- if severity P0 and failure_kind == infra => infra-oncall
- if severity P1 => platform-oncall
- if label team==enterprise => enterprise-sre (special case)
Kristen: We should include SLO burn rate thresholds in the ops handbook and in the release notes for dedicated customers (they care about transient spikes).
Maria: Agreed. Also adding a canary rollout plan: enable alerts for 10% of traffic first, monitor noise for 24h, then flip to 100%. We'll need a feature-flag and alertmanager silences auto-unset.
Ajay: Who's owning the alertmanager config change and the feature flag?
Leo: I'll own the alertmanager mapping and dashboard panels. Maria — can you own the recording rules and runbook updates?
Maria: Yep, I'll do recording rules + runbook. Samir can you handle the min-QPS noise protection logic and quota correlation rule?
Samir: Yep, will add recording and tests.
Kristen: Timeline? Need to announce to oncall rotation before we flip to 100%.
Maria: Plan: this week — record rules + dashboard. Early next week — alertmanager mapping + canary flag. Canary for 24h, then full rollout Wed next week.
Leo: I'll open a PR for alertmanager config and ping oncall-bot for routing changes.
oncall-bot: Reminder: update oncall escalation matrix at https://redwood.internal/oncall/esc-matrix when routing changes land.
Maria: Thanks all. I'll post the PR links here when they're ready. :thumbsup:
Ajay: One last note — add a short eval harness to replay historical telemetry for the last 30 days and check false positive rate before enabling P0 route.
Maria: Good call, putting that in the checklist.
Samir: I'll run the replay and share a short table of FPR by model.
Maria: Closing loop: targets set, owners assigned, canary plan in place. Will update thread with PRs/links. :rocket:
